_comment: Keyboard-layout registry location, the single source for every driver and tool. The registry is a folder of this repository: one <id>/<id>.keylayout (the only source of a layout) plus <id>/meta.toml per layout, and index.json generated from them by tools/build/build-layouts-index.cjs. Drivers download index.json and the chosen .keylayout straight from that folder through raw_url_template; owner and repo come from ../updater/defaults.json. branch stays main until an update-channel registry exists to map the user's channel to its branch. max_file_bytes bounds every download (index or layout). local_folder is the folder, inside the configuration folder, where a driver keeps the layouts it downloaded (<id>.keylayout) next to the index.json they were verified against. ergopti_family is the meta.toml family of the Ergopti layouts: while a layout of another family is active, the drivers switch the Ergopti-only features off.
